title: keel reference registry
description: Keel's product-review and scouting registry for P4, docs/reference-projects.yaml. Lab owns shared clone maintenance and current source observations; this registry preserves product assessment, attribution and adoption evidence at recorded revisions. local_clone is a non-authoritative hint, not an update policy or coverage condition. Public pinned upstream material is sufficient without Lab access.
$comment: Shape unchanged at schema version 1. local_clone remains required and nullable: an optional location hint relative to this repository, outside it (../). scripts/validate.mjs checks the shape and never opens the clone. Licence and review values are assessment snapshots, not claims of current upstream state.

upstream.description: Public upstream URL (a repository, or an organisation when the project spans several), or null when there is no repository to pull (public documentation only).

licenceClass.description: oss: ideas may be re-implemented in keel's own words and code. source-available (for example ELv2): ideas only, no text, code, schema, prompt, template or file layout. proprietary: public documentation only. unverified: the licence has not been read from a licence file; treated as proprietary (ideas from public documentation only) until a refresh review reads it and records the class.

id.description: Registry id, for example openspec or keel-other.

display_name.description: Name as written in docs/00-mandate.md and docs/16-sources-credits.md; a parenthesis may add a disambiguator, for example keel-other (dcsg/keel).

licence.description: Licence evidence used in the recorded product assessment, in words; a historical snapshot, not a claim of current upstream licence. New review notes identify revision, evidence and date.

named_by_owner.description: true when the owner's statement names the project; such a project must be cross-referenced in docs/00-mandate.md and docs/16-sources-credits.md (validate --only references).

local_clone.description: Optional, non-authoritative local clone location hint relative to this repository, outside it (../), or null when no hint is provided. The field remains required for schema-v1 compatibility. Lab owns shared clone maintenance. Never opened by scripts/validate.mjs and never a condition for review coverage, installation, build or runtime.

role.description: What keel takes from the project, in one sentence.

reviewed.description: Review history, oldest first. Empty until the first refresh review reads the project.

review.description: A product assessment or recorded coverage disposition. head identifies material actually examined, never a claim about latest upstream. Scope and notes distinguish examined sources, reasoned exclusions and missing required evidence; a missing required source does not complete review coverage.

head.description: Source commit examined at review time, or null when no source commit was examined (including package/public-documentation-only assessment or a recorded coverage disposition). Preserve historical abbreviations; new notes identify the exact commit when applicable.

branch.description: Branch observed for the examined source revision when relevant. Historical context only; it does not instruct Keel to fetch or advance any shared clone.

version.description: Released version read at review time, or null when the project publishes none.

scope.description: What the pass covered, for example the M0 blueprint or a milestone exit review.

outcome.description: adopted: constructs entered Keel. candidates: proposals or unresolved required evidence await a decision. none: no new idea, or an explicit reasoned exclusion recorded in notes. declined: examined and rejected. Notes must distinguish these dispositions; missing required evidence is never a completed review.

scouting.description: The GitHub scouting record of the refresh discipline (docs/00-mandate.md section 4.3).

last_run.description: Date of the last scouting run, or null before the first.

queries.description: Standing search queries, run verbatim at every refresh review.

candidate.description: A project found by scouting. The owner decides research and adoption; any shared-clone maintenance request belongs to Lab and is separate from Keel adoption.

status.description: proposed: reported to the owner. pulled: cloned locally for analysis. declined, deferred: the owner's decision. adopted: promoted to a project entry.

reason.description: Why the status was chosen; expected once the owner has decided.
